newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's stock exchange to list Argentine shares.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's stock exchange to list Argentine shares.

text.p: Shares from Argentine companies will soon be listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange, the chairman of the Mexican bolsa said on Thursday.
"It will be done shortly.... We are going to start with Argentina and after that we will follow with other Latin American countries," Manuel Robleda said at a news conference.
The news conference took place at during a meeting of the International Federation of Stock Exchanges being held in this resort city.
Mexican officials said earlier in the week they were aiming to make the Mexican bolsa into a center for the trading of Latin American shares.
Robleda also said about 20 Mexican companies are in the line-up to be listed on the Mexican exchange.
